question: Can Parallel Global Voices provide genuinely unexposed, legally usable, content-aligned English-French-Spanish confirmation rows?

source.name: Parallel Global Voices (PGV)
source.rights_statement_from_official_page: Original Global Voices content is available under CC Attribution; distributed document and segment alignment results are CC BY 4.0.
source.citation: Prokopidis, Papavassiliou and Piperidis (LREC 2016), Parallel Global Voices: a Collection of Multilingual Corpora with Citizen Media Stories

allowed_now: Download and hash the official docpairs metadata archive.
Inspect member names, delimiters, language tags and document identifiers.
Count pairwise and three-language document support without reading story text or tokenization outputs.
forbidden_now: Inspect story text or tokenizer scores.
Choose or tune a tokenizer using PGV.
Call pairwise alignments trilingual rows without an explicit common identity and transitivity check.

eligibility_rule.legal_provenance: Pass only if the fetched object is from the official PGV host and the retained official page states the applicable attribution license.
eligibility_rule.content_alignment: Pass document qualification only if stable identifiers show the same story participates in English, French and Spanish links.
eligibility_rule.row_alignment: Sentence-level three-language confirmation remains pending unless pair archives expose common segment identities or a deterministic pivot construction whose one-to-one links agree across all three pairs.
eligibility_rule.freshness: PGV may remain confirmation-only only while no story text or tokenizer outcome is inspected before the tokenizer candidate, vocabulary, preprocessing, metric, cost constraint and deterministic row selection are frozen.
eligibility_rule.selection: After schema qualification, select eligible document or row identities by ascending SHA-256 of the canonical identity; choose the sample size before any tokenizer scoring.

decision_before_diagnostic: PGV is a source candidate, not yet an evaluation set. This diagnostic may advance it only to document-qualified or schema-qualified status.
